# scenario reconnect_rejoins: what the core told the UI, and where it ended up.
# Recorded from internal/irc + internal/state. Regenerate with
# `go test ./internal/transcript -update`, and read doc.go before you do.

stream registration
	conn "connecting"
	conn "ready"
	conn "registering"
	rail
	self <eco>
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"

stream 0 C: join #eco

stream 2 S: :eco!eco@test JOIN #eco / :irc.test 332 eco #eco :topic / :irc.test 353 eco = #eco :@alice eco / :irc.test 366 eco #eco :End of /NAMES list.
	members #eco "alice(@),eco"
	rail
	status #eco "You joined #eco"
	topic #eco "topic"

stream 5 S: @msgid=r1 :alice!alice@test PRIVMSG #eco :before the drop
	msg #eco <alice> "before the drop"
	unread #eco

stream 6 reconnect
	conn "connecting"
	conn "disconnected"
	conn "ready"
	conn "registering"
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
	status server "Disconnected from server."
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"

stream 8 S: :eco!eco@test JOIN #eco / :irc.test 332 eco #eco :topic / :irc.test 353 eco = #eco :@alice eco / :irc.test 366 eco #eco :End of /NAMES list.
	status #eco "You joined #eco"
	topic #eco "topic"

stream 11 S: @msgid=r1 :alice!alice@test PRIVMSG #eco :before the drop

state #eco topic="topic" modes="" key="" members=[alice(@) eco]
	status #eco "You joined #eco"
	msg #eco <alice> "before the drop"
	status #eco "You joined #eco"

state server topic="" modes="" key="" members=[]
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
	status server "Disconnected from server."
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
